jobs.title: Lead Solution Architect with AI Experience
jobs.description:
Lead Solution Architect - AI & Engineering/Eaas

Join Deloitte's AI & Engineering practice and help architect, build, and scale technology solutions that transform mission-critical business operations. In this role, you will help clients modernize platforms, accelerate digital innovation, and unlock value through engineering-led transformation across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud. You'll work with cross-functional teams to shape solution strategy, guide implementation, and deliver business outcomes at scale using technologies including Amazon Web Services and generative artificial intelligence platforms.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Solution Architect you will be responsible for...

Leading solution architecture and engineering efforts for client engagements involving generative artificial intelligence, Amazon Web Services cloud services, data platforms, and enterprise application modernization
Translating business, functional, and technical requirements into scalable architecture designs, reference patterns, implementation roadmaps, and delivery plans
Guiding engineering teams through solution design, Amazon Bedrock integration, Anthropic Claude implementation, application programming interface strategy, security controls, and production deployment across complex enterprise environments
Collaborating with client stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, and delivery leaders to manage priorities, risks, dependencies, and quality throughout the delivery lifecycle
Driving engineering-led innovation by identifying opportunities to modernize platforms, operationalize artificial intelligence capabilities, improve operational performance, and accelerate digital product and platform outcomes

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics
8+ years of experience in software engineering, application architecture, or solution architecture
5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, projects, or workstreams for enterprise technology implementations
Experience designing and implementing cloud-based solutions using Amazon Web Services, including Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon API Gateway, or container-based services
Experience architecting generative artificial intelligence solutions using large language models, prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and enterprise integration patterns
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics
Experience delivering technology transformation programs in a consulting or professional services environment
Experience implementing Anthropic Claude through Amazon Bedrock or application programming interface integration in enterprise environments
Experience with model evaluation, observability, guardrails, and security controls for production artificial intelligence deployments
AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer
Experience presenting architecture recommendations, delivery status, and technical tradeoffs to executive stakeholders

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200 to $278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Edge Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones, including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon, and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software-defined world.

YOUR ROLE

Wind River is seeking an exceptional Senior Solutions Architect to join our Partner Solutions team. In this role, you will identify new opportunities, help shape our strategic vision, and contribute to building the next generation of products that drive innovation across the enterprise and at the edge.

This is a pivotal position requiring a rare combination of deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and outstanding communication skills. The ideal candidate will lead adoption across key industry verticals, architect sophisticated solutions, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to both internal stakeholders and external partners.

Some travel is required

In your daily job, you will:

Technical Leadership: Act as the subject matter expert in emerging markets and technologies, offering guidance to the sales team, clients, and internal stakeholders.
Solution Architecture: Design and architect sophisticated, scalable solutions to solve critical business challenges and drive value for our clients and Wind River. Clearly understanding customer use cases and pain points.
Strategic Client Engagement: Collaborate with C-level executives and senior technical leaders to align emerging solutions with their strategic goals.
Advanced Demonstrations: Create and deliver advanced technical demonstrations and proofs of concept that highlight Wind River’s capabilities today and in the future.
Competitive Analysis: Develop a deep technical understanding of our markets and competitive landscape, enabling clear articulation of our differentiated value proposition.
Product Development Influence: Work closely with Product and R&D teams to provide market insights and client feedback, shaping the product roadmap.
Technical Sales Strategy: Help develop and implement technical sales strategies that drive value to Wind River and differentiate Wind River from the competition.
Research, design, and write requirements where required.
Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver high-quality external content—including white papers, blogs, presentations, and conference talks—to showcase expertise and promote our solutions.
Investigate new technologies and techniques, and research ongoing industry developments.

How You Will Contribute

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are:

Experience: 10+ years in technical sales engineering for embedded software and cloud technologies at the edge, demonstrating both technical and business acumen.
Technical Expertise: Strong background in operating systems preferred (enterprise Linux, embedded Linux, RTOS, mixed-criticality), including boot, kernel, drivers, and performance tuning. Knowledge of middleware and runtimes supporting enterprise and edge workloads (e.g., container runtimes Docker, containerd, Kubernetes / K3s / MicroK8s, AI runtimes and accelerators (TensorRT, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, vendor SDKs).
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear business value and ROI for executives.
Ability to design end-to-end Edge solutions spanning data ingestion, lifecycle, deployment, runtime, and operations.
Hands-on understanding of AI frameworks and model formats (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX)
Proven ability to lead customer-facing technical engagements, including discovery workshops, executive briefings, and architecture reviews.
Skilled at eliciting business objectives, operational constraints, and success criteria, then translating them into viable architectures.
Comfortable running meetings end-to-end with stakeholders ranging from developers to C-suite executives.
Trusted technical advisor capable of aligning enterprise and edge initiatives with business value, ROI, and long-term platform strategy.
Ability to differentiate solutions competitively through architecture, performance, security, and lifecycle value.
Experience creating and delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, proofs of concept (POC), and reference architectures.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

Security Clearance Requirements

Successful candidates must engage in a security clearance process in regard to their citizenship in order to perform fundamental job duties, as per applicable law. In particular, candidates with certain citizenship may not be able to perform such fundamental job duties. Currently, this includes citizens of the following countries: Belarus; Burma; China; Cuba; Iran; North Korea; Syria; Venezuela; Afghanistan; Cambodia; Central African Republic; Cyprus; Democratic Republic of Congo; Ethiopia; Eritrea; Haiti; Iraq; Lebanon; Libya; Russia; Somalia; South Sudan; Sudan; Zimbabwe. Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior AI Product Owner at BDO will serve as the subject matter expert and primary advocate for AI products within the firm. This role involves managing the product lifecycle for existing AI products, from user research and data analysis to feature release and performance monitoring, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer needs. The AI Product Owner will drive the adoption and growth of AI products, fostering innovation and maintaining a robust feedback loop to continuously enhance product offerings and solutions. Key responsibilities include prioritizing the product backlog, defining success metrics, and collaborating with teams to promote the usage of AI products across the organization.

Job Duties

Acts as a subject matter expert for AI products at BDO, capable of demonstrating capabilities to users and groups across the firm
Conducts workshops to gather product feedback from various groups across the firm, ensuring alignment with customer needs and firm strategy
Acts as an advocate and evangelist for AI products within the firm, collaborating with teams to promote their value and encouraging widespread adoption
Establishes and maintains a robust feedback loop with users to continuously gather insights and drive product improvements.
Defines and monitors key performance indicators (KPI’s) and success metrics for AI products.
Conducts user research, data analysis, and collects customer feedback to inform product decisions and iterations
Conducts market research to identify trends and opportunities for AI product enhancements
Monitors the performance and usage of AI products, identifying areas for improvement and driving initiatives to enhance user adoption
Oversees the creation of product roadmaps for AI products and plan feature releases based on business need
Ensures compliance with technical and ethical standards in AI product development
Writes user stories and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring the team delivers the most impactful AI features while maintaining technical and ethical integrity
Engages in team planning, commit to sprints based on average velocity, and integrate testing frequently to address problems early
Oversees the timely release of new features, including writing release notes and ensuring the release team is aligned and prepared as needed
Fosters a culture of innovation and experimentation within the product team, encouraging the exploration of new ideas and technologies to enhance the AI product
Maintains comprehensive documentation of product features, updates, and user feedback, and provide regular reports to senior management on product performance and adoption metrics
Creates and prioritizes work for the AI Engineering team, ensuring a steady flow of tasks
Helps to cultivate a product mindset among the group
Other duties as required

Education

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

High School Diploma or equivalent, required
Bachelor’s degree, preferred; focus in business administration, accounting, computer or information science, or equivalent work experience, preferred

Experience

Eight (8) or more years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in an Agile Environment, required
Broad business experience within a professional services environment, preferred
Experience managing Artificial Intelligence tools, preferred

License(s)/Certification(s)

Certified Scrum Product Owner Certification, preferred

Software

Experience in the following, preferred:
ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or other AI tools
Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, OneNote, OneDrive, PowerBI, Visio
Azure DevOps or Jira
Wireframing software tools

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

A strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, technologies, and trends
Knowledge of software development processes and agile methodologies
Proficiency in defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and make data-driven decisions
Ability to deliver innovative solutions
A passion for quality software crafted with customer-centric problem-solving skills and design thinking
Understanding of ethical implications and considerations in AI development and deployment
Ability to create and lead high-performing cross-functional teams, with team members not directly under his/her/their supervision
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
Recognized as a powerful and effective communicator
Strong presentation skills for demonstrating product capabilities and conducting workshops
Known for high-performance listening and reading comprehension skills, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to explain technologies to business leaders, and business concepts to technologists
Ability to handle conflict-resolution; with an ability to approach a problem from various viewpoints, and achieve consensus
Ability to learn from experience and apply that learning to perform successfully in new situations
Resiliency in ambiguous situations
Comfort with the concepts of transparency, inspection, and adaptation
Focused on relentless improvement
Adept at balancing team and individual responsibilities
Possesses business acumen and interpersonal skills to influence and affect business, culture, and technology changes in a dynamic and complex operating environment
Able to achieve common goals while working ethically and with integrity
Ability to work beyond standard business hours and travel, as needed

Individual salaries that are offered to a candidate are determined after consideration of numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and geography.

National Range: $130,000 – $155,000

Maryland Range: $130,000 – $155,000

At BDO, how we show up matters. We build strong relationships by supporting one another, our clients, and our communities with care, curiosity, and a commitment to helping one another grow and succeed. Here, you’ll find meaningful work, leaders invested in your success, and opportunities to build a career around what matters most to you.

Our purpose is to be the people our clients count on to grow with confidence and achieve what matters most. Our values guide how we bring that purpose to life each day. Together, they shape how we work with one another, serve our clients, and create meaningful impact.

BDO provides assurance, tax, and advisory services to clients across the U.S. and around the world. No matter your role, you’ll be part of a team helping clients navigate complexity and move forward with clarity.

As technology continues to shape how we work, BDO values the ability to apply generative and agentic AI solutions to develop work products, improve workflows and identify potential risks. Across our firm, we emphasize professional judgment in validating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance.

We are proud to be an ESOP company, offering participants a stake in the firm’s success through beneficial ownership and a unique opportunity to enhance their financial well-being. As a qualified retirement plan, the ESOP is a meaningful addition to our comprehensive compensation and Total Rewards benefits* offerings. It also reinforces an ownership mindset that strengthens our connection to one another, our clients, and the future we’re building together.

jobs.title: ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.

The Work

At ICF our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal clients. We bring expertise in cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, data modernization, and digital transformation to support mission-critical government programs.

Join a team accelerating the modernization of a large federal agency's enterprise data and analytics ecosystem. This cloud-based platform provides data storage, analytics, governance, and AI/ML capabilities that enable thousands of users to transform data into actionable insights. As demand continues to grow, the team is focused on migrating legacy workloads, streamlining onboarding and support, expanding platform capabilities, and helping organizations across the enterprise adopt modern data and AI solutions at scale.

The ML Ops Engineer will develop and maintain machine learning pipelines, model registries, deployment frameworks, monitoring solutions, and automated workflows that support enterprise AI initiatives. Working closely with data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, platform engineers, and Trustworthy AI stakeholders, this role enables the successful operationalization of machine learning capabilities across cloud-based environments.

Job Location:
Remote, however, strong preference for candidates who live in the Washington DC Metro Area. There will be occasional onsite meetings on the client site in Washington, DC.

If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations, blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and prohibits personal VPN connections.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain production-grade MLOps pipelines for model training, evaluation, validation, registration, deployment, monitoring, retraining, rollback, and retirement.
Develop reusable MLOps and LLMOps patterns using Azure Databricks, Databricks ML, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Azure Machine Learning, Python, and approved Azure AI services.
Implement experiment tracking, model versioning, model registries, lineage, quality metrics, model cards, and approval workflows using MLflow and Unity Catalog to ensure models are discoverable, reusable, and auditable.
Build automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Databricks Asset Bundles, and Terraform to promote models, code, configurations, and supporting infrastructure consistently across development, test, and production environments.
Deploy and maintain scalable model-serving infrastructure for batch, streaming, real-time, and API-based inference workloads using Databricks Model Serving, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks compute, serverless capabilities, and GPU-enabled configurations, as applicable.
Establish automated testing and evaluation gates for model performance, data quality, fairness, safety, explainability, robustness, privacy, and release readiness.
Implement model and feature monitoring, drift and bias detection, logging, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards using MLflow Model Monitoring, Lakehouse Monitoring, and the broader platform monitoring stack.
Develop automated retraining, champion/challenger promotion, rollback, and model-retirement workflows that prevent performance degradation and support reliable production operations.
Integrate ML workflows with source control, infrastructure provisioning, secrets management, identity and access controls, environment management, and enterprise release processes.
Implement Trustworthy AI controls, including model documentation, impact assessments, audit logging, content safeguards, human oversight, and evaluation evidence aligned with Government-approved standards and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
Partner with data scientists, AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, DevSecOps, Security, and Governance personnel to make models repeatable, testable, deployable, and operationally supportable.
Monitor compute and serving utilization, tune cluster and endpoint configurations, apply tagging conventions, and implement cost-optimization strategies for training and inference workloads.
Troubleshoot failed pipelines, deployment issues, model-serving incidents, performance degradation, and monitoring alerts while supporting root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Create and maintain deployment templates, reusable repositories, operational runbooks, model documentation, release evidence, and technical standards that accelerate responsible AI/ML adoption across the enterprise.

Basic Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract requirements.
Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.
Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three (3) full years out of the last five (5) years.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field or a high school diploma with four (4) additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
6+ years of experience designing and supporting production machine learning solutions in cloud environments.
Master's degree may substitute for two (2) years of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with machine learning operations (MLOps), automated deployment pipelines, and model lifecycle management.
Proficiency in Python and modern software development practices.
Experience with source control systems and CI/CD frameworks.
Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or comparable ML platforms.
Experience implementing model monitoring, automated retraining, and performance tracking solutions.
Knowledge of cloud-native architecture, containerization, and scalable model serving patterns.
Experience supporting Responsible AI, AI governance, or Trustworthy AI initiatives.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and automated environment provisioning.
Strong understanding of cloud cost optimization practices for AI/ML workloads.

#Indeed

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 

Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: Lead Solution Architect with AI Experience
jobs.description:
Lead Solution Architect - AI & Engineering/Eaas

Join Deloitte's AI & Engineering practice and help architect, build, and scale technology solutions that transform mission-critical business operations. In this role, you will help clients modernize platforms, accelerate digital innovation, and unlock value through engineering-led transformation across software, data, artificial intelligence, networks, and hybrid cloud. You'll work with cross-functional teams to shape solution strategy, guide implementation, and deliver business outcomes at scale using technologies including Amazon Web Services and generative artificial intelligence platforms.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Solution Architect you will be responsible for...

Leading solution architecture and engineering efforts for client engagements involving generative artificial intelligence, Amazon Web Services cloud services, data platforms, and enterprise application modernization
Translating business, functional, and technical requirements into scalable architecture designs, reference patterns, implementation roadmaps, and delivery plans
Guiding engineering teams through solution design, Amazon Bedrock integration, Anthropic Claude implementation, application programming interface strategy, security controls, and production deployment across complex enterprise environments
Collaborating with client stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, and delivery leaders to manage priorities, risks, dependencies, and quality throughout the delivery lifecycle
Driving engineering-led innovation by identifying opportunities to modernize platforms, operationalize artificial intelligence capabilities, improve operational performance, and accelerate digital product and platform outcomes

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics
8+ years of experience in software engineering, application architecture, or solution architecture
5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, projects, or workstreams for enterprise technology implementations
Experience designing and implementing cloud-based solutions using Amazon Web Services, including Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon API Gateway, or container-based services
Experience architecting generative artificial intelligence solutions using large language models, prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and enterprise integration patterns
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics
Experience delivering technology transformation programs in a consulting or professional services environment
Experience implementing Anthropic Claude through Amazon Bedrock or application programming interface integration in enterprise environments
Experience with model evaluation, observability, guardrails, and security controls for production artificial intelligence deployments
AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer
Experience presenting architecture recommendations, delivery status, and technical tradeoffs to executive stakeholders

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200 to $278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

As a Senior Databricks FDE, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. Additional responsibilities include:

Client Engagement

Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value GenAI use cases into solutions.
Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.
Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.
Prototype and deliver working AI solutions using industry expertise and emerging capabilities.
Contribute independently within an FDE pod while mentoring newer team members.
Coach client teams and end users on platform capabilities and AI enablement, while building trusted relationships, managing expectations, and supporting long-term engagement success.
Drive end-to-end sales and delivery support by developing demos/POCs, contributing to proposals and orals, articulating business value, and documenting solutions for smooth client handoff and knowledge transfer.

new_jobs.description:
"The best way to predict the future is to invent it." Alan Kay

Imagine taking a platform that already serves hundreds of thousands of companies, already turns a profit and already grows quickly, and then deciding to rebuild the whole thing around AI agents. Not a side project. Not an innovation lab tucked away in a corner. The entire product.

That is exactly what this team is doing, and they want four exceptional Staff and Principal engineers in the room while it happens.

Our client is a profitable, venture-backed AI go-to-market platform headquartered in San Francisco. Revenue teams use it to find the right buyers, start the right conversations and close more deals, powered by one of the largest B2B data sets in the market. Around 250 people, founded over a decade ago, and still moving with the urgency of a Series A. If you have ever wanted genuine scale and genuine momentum in the same job, this is a rare overlap.

The role in one breath

You'll be the senior IC people look for when the problem is hard, ambiguous and expensive to get wrong. You'll own the architecture for a meaningful slice of the platform, either the large-scale distributed systems underneath it or the agent-centric AI products on top, and you'll move between the highest-priority initiatives alongside VPs and the C-suite. Engineering here is expected to shape revenue, not just close tickets.

What you'll be doing

Setting technical direction
for a major area of the platform, from data model to deployment, and backing those choices with clear reasoning.
Taking on the gnarliest problems first:
build versus buy, cost versus latency, consistency versus throughput. The calls you make will ripple through the whole engineering organisation.
Designing agentic systems that hold up in production.
LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval over a very large data set, evaluation loops and the unglamorous plumbing that makes agents reliable rather than merely impressive in a demo.
Scaling the core.
High-volume OLTP workloads, search and indexing at serious scale, and pipelines that keep hundreds of thousands of customers supplied with fresh, accurate data.
Raising the bar across teams
with standards, patterns and reviews that make every engineer around you faster.
Working AI-first yourself.
Agents and AI coding tools are part of how this team designs, investigates and ships every day, and you'll help define what great looks like.

The tech

Languages and frameworks:
Ruby and Ruby on Rails, Python, React
Data:
MongoDB, Elasticsearch, large-scale OLTP and data pipelines
Infrastructure:
Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Google Cloud Platform
AI:
LLM-based systems, agent frameworks, retrieval and evaluation tooling
How you build:
Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code and similar AI-assisted tools, used daily

You don't need every item on day one. Deep strength in distributed systems or LLM-based products, with genuine curiosity about the other half, matters far more than ticking boxes. (Ruby and Mongo are bonuses, not gatekeepers.)

What the hiring team is looking for

This is where we'll be precise, because the hiring team has been very clear about what lands.

Must-haves

8 to 15 years
in backend or full-stack engineering, with real time spent building large-scale distributed systems.
You've owned and operated systems at scale
, serving 100K+ users, and lived with them in production, pager and all.
Strong system design for large-scale data and distributed systems.
You can sketch the architecture, then explain exactly where it will break.
A big tech and startup blend.
Big tech experience is welcome, and you'll also have at least one stint at a reputable high-growth startup (pre-seed to Series D), an AI-native company or a founding engineering team.
A clear upward trajectory.
Your scope has grown with each move, and you've held a Staff-level (or higher) title for a year or more.
Hands-on LLM experience or serious OLTP scale.
The strongest candidates have built LLM-based systems in production, scaled large transactional databases, or both.
Based in the San Francisco Bay Area
and happy to be in the SF office three days a week.

The profile that really shines

The hiring team particularly loves engineers currently at a reputable, high-growth company who bring either a strong database background or production LLM work. A former data engineer who has branched out into distributed systems and AI is a standout archetype here.

Nice to have

Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB or Elasticsearch in production
Daily, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, with a story about how they changed the way you ship
A strong CS degree (far less important once you have five or more years of excellent work behind you)

A quick note on fit

To save everyone time: this seat is for builders of core platforms and AI products, so forward-deployed engineering backgrounds aren't the target. Long tenures where scope stayed flat, or a pattern of very short stints, tend not to progress either. If your career shows steady growth and real ownership, you're exactly who we want to hear from.

Why engineers say yes

Scale you can feel.
Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of companies and millions of users from your first week.
A rebuild, not a maintenance job.
Rebuilding a profitable product around agents is the rarest kind of greenfield: real users, real data, real stakes.
A seat at the table.
You'll work directly with engineering and product leadership, and your architectural calls will shape the business.
Autonomy and ownership.
A culture built on extreme ownership, bold experimentation and continuous learning.
Profitable and growing.
The freedom to make long-term technical bets without runway anxiety.

The package

Base salary up to $412K
, depending on level (Staff or Principal)
Meaningful equity
plus annual bonus
Hybrid:
three days a week in the San Francisco office
Visa transfers welcome
(including H-1B transfers and OPT)
A focused four-step interview process
centred on your real experience and how you solve problems
Four openings
, so there is genuine room for more than one great engineer

Ready to build what comes next?

If you've scaled distributed systems, shipped LLM-powered products and want your next role to define an AI-native platform at serious scale, we'd love to talk.

Hit apply with your resume and tell us about the largest system you've owned and the most interesting thing you've built with LLMs. Every application is read by a real recruiter at Big Wave Digital, and we'll be in touch quickly if there's a match.

Staff Technologist-AI Architect

Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)
builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.
From applied research to advanced engineering, the Engineering Technologist team has the expertise to
shape ground-breaking products, material and processes. It's a fascinating field of work. We're involved in
assessing the competition, developing technology and product strategies and generating intellectual
property. We lead technology investigations, analyze industry capabilities and recommend potential
acquisitions or vendor partner opportunities. Our insights influence product architecture and definitions.
And we work with colleagues across the business to ensure our products always lead the way.

Join us as a Staff Technologist-AI Architect
on our ISG-CTO
team
in Santa Clara, California
to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

What you'll achieve

As a Staff Technologist-AI Architect
, you will architect Dell's next-generation AI Architecture (including the Dell AI Factory) by driving the empirical characterization, performance modeling, and full-stack integration of frontier AI models and autonomous agentic systems. You will evaluate cutting-edge model architectures, build automated performance benchmarking harnesses across diverse accelerators, and design turnkey production architectures bridging Kubernetes, low-latency inference runtimes, enterprise data platforms, and confidential hardware fabrics.

You will:

Architect Dell's Next-Gen AI Architectures :
Drive end-to-end reference architectures and system-level validation for enterprise-scale AI platforms (e.g., Dell AI Factory, rack-scale IR7000/IR9100 liquid-cooled systems, and modular HGX/NVLink clusters).
Frontier Model Characterization & Trend Tracking :
Track, evaluate, and characterize emerging frontier model architectures and reasoning paradigms (e.g., dense Transformers, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts like DeepSeek-V3/V4 and Llama 4 Scout, hybrid attention, and native multimodal models).
Hands-On Deployment & Performance Benchmarking :
Design and automate hands-on benchmarking pipelines to rigorously measure critical inference metrics across real-world workloads (e.g., profiling Time to First Token [TTFT], Inter-Token Latency [ITL], prefill/decode disaggregation, KV-cache memory offload, and FP8/FP4 quantization).
Agentic Frameworks & Multi-Agent Systems: Understand and design for autonomous, multi-step agentic execution patterns, tool calling, and execution loops (e.g.NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes).
Data & Context Layer for AI :
Integrate high-throughput data pipelines and context-grounding platforms to eliminate ETL and prevent hallucinations (e.g., Dell AI Data Platform [AIDP], Starburst/Trino federated SQL, Apache Spark, Elasticsearch vector indexing, and RAG architectures).

Take the first step towards your dream career

15+ years of professional experience with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering (Advanced degree highly preferred)
Deep technical understanding of GPU architectures and emerging alternate accelerators to match model workloads to optimal hardware.
Experience with Production Storage & High-Speed Data Fabrics: Architect high-throughput, low-latency data and network fabrics essential for continuous AI pipelines (e.g., Dell PowerScale all-flash NFS with GPUDirect Storage [GDS], Dell ObjectScale S3, RoCEv2/Spectrum-X Ethernet, and InfiniBand).

new_jobs.title: AI Research Scientist, Materials Discovery
new_jobs.description:
At Logical Intelligence, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products.

About the Role

As a Research Scientist
, you will join an interdisciplinary team of quantum chemists, physicists, ML scientists, and engineers, where the biggest impact comes from working together. You'll develop the AI models that drive our discovery loop, proposing novel molecules that are then synthesized and tested in our partner labs, and you'll see your predictions confronted with real measurements.

What You’ll Do

Tackle the core research problems in our discovery loop: how to generate promising candidates, screen them reliably, and decide which molecules are worth testing next.
Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held-out chemical families, accuracy against both quantum-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty estimates, prospective tests where the model predicts before the lab measures, and tracking across model versions.
Compare AI predictions with measurements, investigate disagreements, and turn what you learn into concrete model changes, in collaboration with chemists, AI researchers and engineers.
Design experiments with our partner labs so that each round of synthesis and testing is as informative as possible.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have

A PhD in machine learning or a Master’s or Bachelor’s with relevant industry experience
Working knowledge in energy-based models, diffusion or score-based models, or similar generative approaches, and an interest in going deeper
Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it working alongside our chemists.
Experience designing evaluations and experiments that correlate with downstream performance
A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications, open-source software

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Discovery & Recommendations
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About The Team

Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.

About The Role

We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office.

You Will:

Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other.
Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data.
Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months.
Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap.
Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality.
Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists.

You Have:

A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience.
3+ years as a data scientist in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, with hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails.
Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results.
Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R.
A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership.

Bonus Points

An MS or PhD in a quantitative field.
Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold-start problems.
Experience with multi-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals.
Experience building proxy metrics for long-term outcomes, or estimating long-term effects from long-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling).
Experience with two-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply.
Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short-form video, social or marketplaces.
Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!).

new_jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position overview

About The Role

Stanford Research Computing is seeking an AI Research Computing Facilitator who will bring the perspective of the research community to the selection, support, and processes associated with enterprise and research focused AI platforms (eg. Claude for Education, ChatGPT, etc). The individual will provide feedback into choosing, evaluating, approving, supporting, and using AI tools that are of key importance to the Stanford research community and will have service ownership responsibilities associated with AI tools focused on research (eg. Claude Science, Rosalind, etc).

The SRC team runs large scale computing and data platforms and the successful candidate will support the deployment of AI tools in these environments ensuring alignment between campus research computing resources and enterprise AI tools owned by the UIT Enterprise Technologies (ET) AI team.

In this role you will interact directly with research teams but will also spend a significant amount of your time working with the UIT Enterprise Technologies AI team, Information Security Office, SRC staff, and other key stakeholders.

This is a full time fixed-term position for a 3 year term. It is an onsite or hybrid position.

US citizenship or permanent residency required. This position cannot sponsor a work permit now or in the future.

Responsibilities

AI tool evaluation, approval and communication (about 50%)

In collaboration with UIT ET and other stakeholders help shape how AI tools for research are evaluated and approved at Stanford, participating in the process for identifying, evaluating, and approving new tools in a timely manner.
Work with the research community to identify, and prioritize, new AI tools to evaluate (eg. coding assistants, literature and data-analysis tools, agent platforms, research-specific AI services, etc.)
Work with the AI team in University IT’s Enterprise Technology to evaluate AI tools, publish the approved-tools list, create and update documentation of the approved AI tools for research, as well as communicate results of evaluations to the relevant research communities at Stanford.
In collaboration with UIT ET shepherd selected tools through Stanford’s security, privacy, legal, regulatory, and procurement review.
Communicate approved tools to the research community: plain-language guidance on what each tool may be used for, announcements of new approvals and changes, and answers to researcher questions.
Collect feedback from the research community and usage data after approval, and recommend renewals, changes or retirement of tools.

Research consultation (about 20%)

Meet with researchers to understand their questions and data, advise which approved tools to use as well as take in their requests of new tools needing evaluation. Build an evaluation request pipeline.
Help researchers apply approved AI tools in research.
Advise on sound and responsible practice of utilizing AI tools in research: evaluation and validity, reproducibility, sensitive data (HIPAA, FERPA, CUI), IRB considerations and licensing.
Participate in fielding SRC tickets and requests from the research community.

Deploying & Evaluating AI tools on HPC platforms (about 15%)

Help researchers move AI work onto our HPC systems: accounts, Jupyter and Open OnDemand, environments, Slurm jobs and data transfer.
Troubleshoot common AI workflow problems and work with other SRC staff to resolve issues researchers encounter.
Connect researchers to campus, cloud, and national resources (NAIRR Pilot, ACCESS).

Training, communications, and documentation (about 15%)

Run workshops and office hours, focused on approved AI tools and on running AI work on HPC. Communicate approved AI tools to researcher community members.
Update and publish up to date information about approved AI tools for research. Write how-to guides and examples to go with approved tools.

Required Qualifications

Education and experience

Master’s degree in a research field that uses computation (any discipline, including data science, statistics, computer science, the sciences, social sciences or engineering) plus 2 years of relevant experience; or a PhD; or a bachelor’s plus 4 years; or an equivalent combination.
Has applied machine learning or AI to real research or analysis problems, end to end: from framing the question through evaluating and reporting results.

Technical Skills

Broad, hands-on knowledge of the current AI tool landscape for research (chat and coding assistants, literature and data-analysis tools, agent platforms) and experience evaluating AI tools and platforms.
Understanding of how AI tools handle data: retention, use of inputs for training, access controls, and integrations.
Working knowledge of LLMs and generative AI for research: eg. prompting, API use, open-weight models, autonomous agents, model training, external data integration such as RAG, tool use/function calling, web search integration, etc.
Comfortable on Linux and able to run batch and interactive work on an HPC cluster (Slurm preferred), or learn quickly with training.

Professional (“soft”) Skills

Excellent listener and translator: understands a researcher’s field and goals and explains AI options in their terms.
Writes clear, accurate evaluations and plain-language guidance that turn approval decisions into helpful documentation.
Works effectively across organizational boundaries, building trust across diverse stakeholder groups with a goal of moving processes forward to support research teams.
Good judgment and candor: will say when a tool is not ready, not safe for certain data, or not the right fit.
Organized and persistent: tracks many tools, reviews and requests at once and follows through.
Curious and self-directed learner in a fast-moving field, committed to welcoming support for researchers of all backgrounds.

Experience

Preferred qualifications

PhD, or substantial research experience as a graduate student, postdoc or research staff member, using AI in a domain science, social science, humanities or health field.
Experience evaluating, piloting or rolling out software or AI tools in a university or other large organization.
Experience working with central IT, information security, privacy or procurement on technology reviews.
2+ years as a research computing facilitator, data science consultant, or in a researcher-facing role in higher education.

Technical Skills

Experience with one or more application areas such as: scientific foundation models, NLP and text-as-data, computer vision and imaging, time series, or tabular data.
Building LLM applications for research: eg., RAG, embeddings and vector databases, structured extraction, evaluation of LLM outputs, agent frameworks.
Open OnDemand, JupyterHub and containers (Apptainer) from a user’s point of view.
Familiarity with AI governance, research ethics and sensitive-data environments.

Professional (“soft”) Skills

Consulting skills: scopes engagements, sets expectations and follows up.
Experience building communities, such as user groups, hackathons or communities of practice.
Comfortable presenting to a variety of audiences: faculty, students, staff, department chairs, and leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Duties
:

Researcher Engagement:

Lead collaboration with cross-functional technical teams, faculty and researchers to understand their research goals and identify technical obstacles and solutions for highly complex research questions.
Assist researchers in the identification of appropriate computational platforms (locally and externally); the tuning, debugging, optimization, and enhancement of their existing algorithms on mid-scale HPC, cloud computing, and national facilities.
Advise researchers in the best use of a broad set of cyberinfrastructure systems, tools, and software.
Build a deep understanding of specific research activities associated with strategic campus priorities.
Regularly attend research meetings to develop both formal and informal pathways for regular exchanges of information.
Develop and surface metrics to demonstrate effectiveness and impact on researcher productivity and success as a result of engagements.

Solutions Development:

Formulate complex and innovative technical strategies and engineer them to completion to achieve unique research objectives and overcome any research challenges, using external vendors as needed.
Lead the development of frameworks that assist researchers in analyzing and visualizing data to uncover insights and support research findings. Consult on the creation and management of large, variable datasets in order to enable their preparation and use in research for modeling and analysis.
Execute technical solutions to meet the most complex research needs, including machine learning algorithms, text and image processing techniques, API programming, custom full-stack applications, automated web scraping, and crowdsourcing pipelines, to inform research findings. Facilitate the design, debugging, and automating/scripting of novel complex research workflows with researchers. Develop enhancements to workflows.
Synthesize complex patterns in research and evaluate potential platforms, including meeting with representatives from emerging industries and analyzing tools and systems through the lens of academic research, spanning Artificial Intelligence, Big Data and Cloud Technologies.
Continuously adapt to and formulate solutions using evolving technologies and methodologies to accelerate research development and enable new research frontiers. Leverage leading-edge technical knowledge and interpersonal skills to support and enhance academic research.
Ensure the feasibility of support and security of such solutions, and compliance with applicable local, campus or national policies, practices and regulations.

Documentation/Training:

Collaborate with research leads and teams to research and develop efforts to enhance the team's capabilities in research support, including training sessions, testing new data collection methods, and staying abreast of relevant literature.
Participate and present at industry conferences and meetings to understand the latest academic research papers and computer source code. Replicate results from diverse fields as needed.
Build advanced curriculum and teach workshops on topics such as software porting techniques, parallelization and optimization methodologies, computational platforms, and data management, ensuring that those workshops are aligned with unit goals, referenced technologies are supported and supportable, materials are vetted collaboratively by peers and team, and all sessions are evaluated by participants.
Lead the development and delivery of documentation and training for faculty and research staff.
Document all interactions, solutions and approaches discussed with researcher-facing and systems-facing peers.

Partnership/Collaboration:

Connect and coordinate interactions between researchers and technology providers, management and technology partners. Connect research teams with external experts, resources and local team members, peers and management as needed to facilitate solution development.
Work closely and collaboratively with peers to ensure that proposed solutions do not adversely affect overall system performance and that solutions are consistent with local policies.

What's In It For You

Trane Technologies Connected Solutions Advanced Analytics Team is seeking a Senior Data Scientist
to join a small-but-growing entrepreneurial technical team that are applying innovative analytic approaches to extremely complex problems in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) space.

The Senior Data Scientist will be responsible for building predictive maintenance and anomaly detection models in support of our mission-critical digital strategy initiatives. Lead the development and implementation of state of the art machine learning models to enable predictive and prescriptive maintenance of components and subsystems (compressors, heat exchangers, pumps, fans, etc)
Take ownership for the entire data science workflow including project scoping, exploratory data analysis, model development, hyperparameter tuning, testing, deployment and monitoring

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Applied AI Engineer / Forward-Deployed Engineer based in Seattle.

As a Principal Applied AI Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering practical AI-powered solutions that address real-world business challenges. You will work directly with business stakeholders and clients to identify opportunities, translate complex needs into technical solutions, and lead projects from initial discovery through production deployment. Combining strong software engineering expertise with advanced knowledge of large language models, you will build intelligent workflows, AI agents, and enterprise applications. You will also drive the integration of AI technologies with business platforms, APIs, and secure data environments. This hands-on position offers significant technical ownership and autonomy in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Your work will help organizations become more connected, efficient, and intelligent through responsible AI innovation.

Accountabilities

Lead the development and implementation of production-ready AI applications, working closely with clients, internal teams, and business stakeholders to transform operational challenges into scalable, secure, and effective technical solutions.

Own the full development lifecycle of AI-powered solutions, from business discovery and requirements gathering to prototyping, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Collaborate directly with clients, business teams, and leadership to identify opportunities and translate business requirements into practical AI applications.
Design, build, and deploy AI-assisted workflows, intelligent agents, and applications using large language models and modern development frameworks.
Integrate AI models and services with Google Workspace, Gemini Enterprise, internal systems, APIs, and approved external data sources.
Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and other data retrieval approaches that enable applications to access and use relevant business information.
Implement secure data access mechanisms, permissions, tool calling, and integrations that respect organizational and client-specific access controls.
Establish reliable application architectures with appropriate testing, monitoring, error handling, and performance optimization.
Evaluate AI models, development tools, and cloud services, balancing functionality, reliability, privacy, security, and operating costs.
Gather stakeholder feedback, troubleshoot technical issues, and continuously improve applications following production launches.
Create reusable technical patterns, document development approaches, and share knowledge to support future engineering initiatives.
Monitor emerging developments in applied AI, LLMs, AI agents, frameworks, and related technologies to identify opportunities for innovation.
Identify ways to incorporate AI into internal operations and client-facing solutions while promoting a human-centered approach to technology.
Deliver key initial milestones within the first 90 days, including one useful internal AI-powered workflow, one client-relevant demonstration, and documented technical patterns covering testing, permissions, reliability, and performance.

Requirements

You are a highly experienced software engineer with a strong background in applied AI development and a proven ability to turn experimental concepts into reliable production applications. You combine technical depth with practical problem-solving skills, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and are comfortable taking ownership of complex projects in fast-moving environments.

8+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent hands-on engineering expertise, including recent experience developing LLM-powered applications.
Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript.
Hands-on experience building, integrating, and deploying applications using APIs and cloud-based services.
Demonstrated experience developing AI-powered applications, workflows, and agents using large language models (LLMs).
Practical experience implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), data retrieval, tool calling, and other common LLM application patterns.
Proven ability to take AI-powered applications from prototype to production and provide ongoing support after deployment.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including application architecture, testing, CI/CD, and deployment practices.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise platforms, business systems, APIs, and external data sources.
Knowledge of data permissions, security, privacy, and responsible management of sensitive company and client information.
Ability to design reliable applications with effective monitoring, error handling, and performance management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and navigate ambiguity.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and taking projects from initial ideas to fully functioning production solutions.
Experience with modern AI coding tools and the ability to incorporate them effectively into development workflows.

Candidates should also be prepared to discuss an AI-powered application they personally built and launched, explaining the original business problem, technical architecture, development and deployment process, testing approach, challenges encountered, and improvements made after launch.

Annual base salary: $175,000–$210,000.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with options available to suit individual needs.
Paid sick time and 10 paid holidays.
Flexible vacation policy that supports work-life balance and personal well-being.
